blocks.text: Thank you both. To bring the timing together in one place: Amy Carter will have the first set of executive messages for {{fact:f:E-2023-001.client}} to you by the end of the week, and I will hold a short window early next week for us to walk through it together.

On which audience leads, I would rather settle it with you on that call than guess at it now, so the wording sets around your view and not ours. If it helps, I will send two or three possible times this afternoon.

In the meantime, if anyone else on the Suarez-Jones side should see the draft before it is final, let me know and we will get it in front of them. I have you, Jennifer Herrera, as our approver on the final wording, so nothing goes out without your sign-off. I will follow up with those call windows shortly.
